question.answerB: Provide necessary assistance to accident victims.
question.answerC: Call the emergency medical team.
predefinedAnswers: Move the vehicle off the road so that it does not obstruct traffic.
Provide necessary assistance to accident victims.

summary.stem: Which of these actions are you not allowed to do if you are involved in an accident that kills someone?
answers: Move the vehicle off the road so that it does not obstruct traffic.
Provide necessary assistance to accident victims.

question.text: Which of the following behaviors towards an injured person in an accident may result in criminal liability?
question.answerA: Failure to provide any assistance.
question.answerB: Any unprofessional rescue operation.
question.answerC: Any unprofessional and erroneous rescue action.
predefinedAnswers: Any unprofessional and erroneous rescue action.

summary.stem: Which of the following behaviors towards an injured person in an accident may result in criminal liability?
answers: Any unprofessional and erroneous rescue action.

question.text: Is everyone obliged to provide first aid to victims of a road accident?
question.answerA: No, because only people with medical education can provide help.
question.answerB: Yes, because you can perform some rescue operations yourself.
question.answerC: No, because any mistakes may result in criminal liability.

Yes, because you can perform some rescue operations yourself.
No, because any mistakes may result in criminal liability.

question.text: How should you protect a road accident victim who is conscious but has a head injury that is bleeding?
question.answerA: Lay flat and apply a sterile gauze dressing to the wound.
question.answerB: Place in a semi-sitting position, apply a sterile gauze dressing to the wound and calm down.
question.answerC: Place in a side lying position (fixed side position) without dressing.
